name: 導引
description: 像醫院導引標示一樣清楚的研究室網站：首頁是分區目錄看板，每個分區有自己的顏色，中英雙語標示。

slots.zh: 以實證護理與臨床教育研究，回應病人與照護者每天面對的問題。
slots.en: Evidence-based nursing and clinical education research for the questions patients and carers face every day.

slots.zh: 我們相信好的照護來自好的問題。研究室從臨床現場出發，和病人、家屬與護理同仁一起找出值得研究的問題。
slots.en: Good care starts with good questions. We begin at the bedside and work with patients, families and nurses to find the questions worth studying.

slots.zh: 研究室成立於 2018 年（範例），結合量性與質性方法，探討慢性病照護、護理教育與數位健康介入的成效。
slots.en: Founded in 2018 (sample), the lab combines quantitative and qualitative methods to study chronic illness care, nursing education and digital health interventions.

slots.zh: （範例）我們與醫院護理部、社區健康中心長期合作，讓研究成果回到病房與社區，成為護理師日常可用的工具。
slots.en: (Sample) Long-standing partnerships with hospital nursing departments and community health centres bring our findings back to wards and neighbourhoods as tools nurses can use.

slots.zh: 慢性病自我管理、護理教育、數位健康照護
slots.en: Chronic illness self-management, nursing education, digital health

slots.zh: 招收碩博士生與研究助理，歡迎來信
slots.en: We welcome master's and PhD students and research assistants

slots.zh: 我們關注病人與照護者在真實臨床情境中的需求，以研究支持更好的照護決策。
slots.en: We study what patients and carers need in real clinical settings, and turn it into evidence for better care.

slots.zh: 發展並評估以護理師為主導的衛教與追蹤模式，協助糖尿病與心衰竭病人在家中維持穩定。
slots.en: We develop and test nurse-led education and follow-up models that help people with diabetes and heart failure stay well at home.

slots.zh: 以情境模擬與回饋設計，縮短護理學生與新進護理師從課堂到臨床的落差。
slots.en: Scenario-based simulation and feedback design that narrow the gap between classroom and ward for students and new graduate nurses.

slots.zh: 設計病人與家屬願意使用的數位工具，並以實證檢驗其安全性與效果。
slots.en: Digital tools that patients and families actually want to use, tested for safety and effect.
